pages.text: Well, that didn't work.$(br2)So long as the Command Block powering the Wither Storm remains intact, there's no way to stop it. It's time for a new goal: Creating a $(item)Command Block$() of your own along with a weapon capable of using it.$(br2)$(item)Charoite$(), a material forged using tainted dust, will suffice for the latter.

Your quest will focus on finding six $(item)Coruscant Panels$() and a $(item)Redstone Heart$(). These pieces have their own entries in this book to help you.$(br2)Once you've found all of these, hopefully the Wither Storm will evolve to a point where you can do more.
